concepts.name: Fresh coat, fresh crush
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-resolution raster concept board for the PC GAME "I Can Fix Him": a comedic dating sim about flirting with handsome personifications of a decrepit apartment's repairs. The user selected the tactile paint/tape DIY concept 02 and the bold home-renovation television concept 07, and wants a second broad exploration within those two visual families. It should be flirty, witty, lively, aimed at adults. Renovation is the visual vocabulary; comedic dating sim is the emotional identity.
Deliverable: wide approximately 2:1 board, two clearly separated GAME screenshots side by side, LEFT title/menu with a new matching logo, RIGHT conversation gameplay. Small numbered direction name along the top. The right screen can be slightly wider to prioritize assessing the UI. Screens fill nearly all canvas, no laptop/phone mockup, no website, no navigation/sidebar for an app, no explanatory paragraphs or swatch legend.
Reference role: style board(s) supply visual family; the original screenshot supplies the actual warm painterly 3D kitchen, handsome adult Lukey's auburn curls, smile, blue eyes, white tank top, bandages, plumbing details. Preserve the recognizable existing 3D character and background, do NOT redesign character appearance, scene or rendering style. Recompose the reference game scene only as needed to fit the new UI layout. This is principally UI art direction.
Title text exactly "I Can Fix Him". Title menu "Continue", "New Game", "Options", "Credits", "Exit", with one obvious primary action. Character art can appear on menu but logo and menu should remain clear.
Dialogue text: speaker "LUKEY", subtitle "The Leaks", line "Not A leak. THE leaks. Plural. I'm a franchise." Three replies: "1. It's my house now.", "2. Cute, though.", "3. I'll fix what's broken." Underline "franchise" to show a clickable topic. UI must include readable compact "Romance", "Friendship", "Friction" indicators and small "Kitchen", "Week 1", "Repairs 0/4" HUD. Show reply 2 focused with a coherent focus treatment, not implying an outcome for every option.
Legibility: clean high-contrast body text, clear line/reply hierarchy, no textures under small text. Text may be hand-lettered only for names, headers and logo. Keep face unobscured and actual UI less cluttered than decorative title graphics. Each new concept must have a distinct structural UI idea, not just a palette swap of the reference. Avoid heavy repeated pipe ornaments and huge duplicate portraits; do not give all three relationship axes the same unlabeled pink bar.
No new story people, no ghost spoilers, no new game modes. No dark horror, beige editorial minimalism, generic rounded corporate app cards or smartphone dating app UI.
Specific concept: 09 — Fresh coat, fresh crush. A disciplined evolution of 02: vivid fuchsia painter's tape, warm white, apricot and muted seafoam; authentic paint-roller edge shapes, only two or three tactile accents, generous breathing room. Layout: low-profile full-width warm-white dialogue strip along the lower quarter, LUKEY on a brushstroke name tab slightly above its left edge; choices sit in three broad horizontally aligned paint-swatch chips directly underneath, with enough room for the short copy. Relationship indicators sit in one tidy row below the name and away from line text. Title logo expressive painted brush lettering on a single paint-test patch, Continue as one confident broad roller stripe. Cleaner handmade dating comedy, NOT a distressed corkboard covering everything.
Image1 is the chosen style-family reference. Image2 is original game scene reference.
